What if everything you dreamt about actually came true?
Meet the Dream Family, where one son's dreams have a way of turning into reality, and bedtime is just the beginning of the chaos! From bizarre dreams to unexpected real-life consequences, watch this family navigate the funniest, weirdest and most unpredictable situations, one dream at a time.
Because in this family, even a little nap can turn into a BIG problem!
Watch Dream Family, a family comedy show by FilterCopy.
